categories.name: Gemma
categories.reason: Seven real local browser rituals completed across Cursed v1 and Useful/Chaotic v1/v2/v3. Schema/evidence checks and exports passed; the paired inheritance review documents improvements and remaining limits.
categories.workingUserScenario: Inspect pallets/flask + jqlang/jq, select a ritual mode, generate a source-linked creature and export PNG/SVG. Final Useful/Chaotic use prompt v3; original Cursed proof uses v1.
categories.costEvidence: Owner reports Workers Free; no billing, card or quota setting was changed. Seven completed rituals are recorded overall; exact upstream repair/call count, Neurons and billing dashboard were not captured.
